fusions.name: Silk Shot
fusions.desc: Spits a strand that deals 10 damage with a 50% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Wrapped Bite
fusions.desc: A quick bite that deals 8 damage to an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, uses that affliction up and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Strung Barrier
fusions.desc: Strings a wall of silk 5 tiles long that blocks enemies for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Web Tender
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage.
